promise: "We will pursue our manifest destiny into the stars, launching American astronauts to plant the Stars and Stripes on the planet Mars."
description: In his second inaugural address Trump pledged to launch American astronauts to plant the US flag on Mars, a goal he first tied to the end of his term at an October 2024 rally. As of August 2026 no crewed Mars mission was scheduled, and orbital dynamics mean a landing could not occur before 2029 at the earliest.
evidence: No crewed Mars mission approved or scheduled as of mid-2026
NYT analysis: a Mars landing cannot happen before 2029 due to orbital windows

promise: Stargate will invest up to $500 billion in US AI infrastructure, with $100 billion starting immediately
description: At the White House, Altman — with SoftBank's Masayoshi Son and Oracle's Larry Ellison — announced Stargate, a partnership to invest up to $500 billion in US AI data centres over four years, promising 10 gigawatts of computing capacity and $100 billion in near-immediate spending. Construction advanced across multiple states, but by 2026 funding questions persisted (Musk publicly said 'they don't have money'), and Reuters reported OpenAI widening the project's scope and pursuing debt financing to pay for chips.
evidence: Multiple Stargate data centre projects under construction by 2025-2026
Reuters (Sept 2025): scope widened, debt financing sought; Musk's 'they don't have money' criticism echoed by analysts
